description.value: Wildfire Bakery is a small, family-owned artisan bakery on Victoria's Quadra Street, operating since 1998 and specializing in naturally leavened sourdough breads baked in a wood-fired oven. They grind all their whole grain flours using a custom stone mill, sourcing certified organic and mostly BC-grown wheat, spelt, and rye. Cyclists will find a broad selection of fresh loaves, croissants, muffins, pastries, custom cakes, and packaged grocery items like pasta and granola.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (10 spaces) at 67m. Total: 10 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms all key contact details matching OSM. The shop page lists a 'Grocery Items' category (pasta, granola) alongside bread and pastries, supporting a basic groceries value=true. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any other cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site or in OSM tags, so those remain null. One minor concern: OSM lists Saturday closing at 15:00, but the website consistently shows Saturday hours as 8am–5pm (same as weekdays).
concerns: OSM opening_hours lists Saturday as 08:00–15:00, but the website consistently shows Saturday as 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. (same as weekdays). OSM hours may be outdated; last check_date was 2025-09-06.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible artisan bakery with a confirmed web presence, current hours, and a broad product range useful to touring cyclists.
